system.description:
A creature you touch becomes Invisible for the duration. The Jutsu ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a Jutsu. This lasts for up to 1 hour provided you maintain concentration and the invisible creature doesn’t end the effect themselves.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, the affected creature does not lose the Invisible condition if they make an attack roll, deal damage or cast a jutsu. If cast in this way, This lasts for up to 1 minute provided you maintain concentration.
